methodology: Hand-curated examples from original regulatory and industry sources. Different event classes are never equivalent. A listing as authorized is NOT a penalty or allegation. Monetary penalties are FINTRAC-imposed amounts, not victim losses; appeal outcomes must be checked for updates.

entries.name: Wealthsimple Investments Inc.
entries.status: Authorized platform listing / amended regulatory decision
entries.title: CSA lists Wealthsimple Investments in authorized Canadian crypto trading platforms
entries.summary: CSA's authorized-platform list references a December 22, 2025 amended decision. This is regulatory authorization information, not an enforcement penalty.

entries.name: Wealthsimple
entries.title: Wealthsimple describes scams targeting customer accounts and impersonation of its brand
entries.summary: Institution-issued consumer protection guidance. Scammer impersonation does not establish platform wrongdoing.

entries.name: Shakepay Inc.
entries.title: CSA lists Shakepay among authorized Canadian crypto platforms
entries.summary: A regulatory authorization/decision listing and not a penalty or fraud allegation.

entries.name: Xeltox Enterprises Ltd. (Cryptomus)
entries.status: Penalty imposed; appealed to Federal Court (per notice)
entries.title: FINTRAC penalty on Xeltox Enterprises Ltd. (Cryptomus)
entries.summary: FINTRAC reported a C$176,960,190 administrative penalty for 2,593 contraventions covering six categories of violations. The notice says the company appealed.

entries.name: Binance Holdings Limited
entries.status: Penalty imposed; appeal reported in FINTRAC index
entries.title: FINTRAC administrative penalty against Binance Holdings Limited
entries.summary: FINTRAC index reports C$6,002,000 imposed in May 2024 for two violations. Appeal status needs checking before downstream use.

entries.name: Saskatchewan Indian Gaming Authority
entries.status: Penalty imposed; appealed to Federal Court
entries.title: FINTRAC penalty on Saskatchewan Indian Gaming Authority
entries.summary: AML program and suspicious-transaction reporting violations found by FINTRAC, with C$1,175,000 imposed; decision appealed.

entries.name: CNE Casino
entries.title: FINTRAC penalty on Canadian National Exhibition (CNE Casino)
entries.summary: C$199,000 penalty imposed for two administrative AML program violations; FINTRAC reports an appeal.

entries.name: British Columbia Lottery Corporation
entries.status: Penalty imposed; later disposition not checked
entries.title: FINTRAC reported C$1,075,000 administrative penalty on BCLC
entries.summary: FINTRAC index records a 2025 AML compliance penalty; do not assume culpability for customer fraud.

entries.name: Atlantic Lottery Corporation
entries.title: FINTRAC penalized Atlantic Lottery for AML compliance violations
entries.summary: FINTRAC identifies reporting and compliance program weaknesses, including inconsistent implementation across operating sites.

entries.name: Nova Scotia Gaming Corporation
entries.title: FINTRAC penalty on Nova Scotia Gaming Corporation
entries.summary: The FINTRAC notice documents AML suspicious-transaction reporting and compliance deficiencies.

entries.name: New Brunswick Lotteries and Gaming Corporation
entries.title: FINTRAC penalty on New Brunswick Lotteries and Gaming Corporation
entries.summary: Administrative AML penalty for suspicious transaction reporting violation.
